subject: Healthwise — kickoff plan, primary steward, and initial ops slate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healthwise.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthwise.ai
Date: 2027-10-04T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff — Healthwise implementation kickoff & owners

Hi team,

Finalized the commercial paperwork this morning — Healthwise has signed the SOW and their PO is in progress (procurement looped). Quick summary for handoff:

- Account: Healthwise (midwest regional provider)
- ARR: $420k/year (starts Nov 1)
- Primary contact (product/ops): Alyssa Chen (see cc)
- Main objective: roll out Redwood inference for clinical note summarization across 3 pilot hospitals (PHI workflow; on-prem/private deployment)
- Initial scope: pilot with 3 models (summarization + reranking), private deployment in their AWS account (VPC peering), 8-week pilot target to validate latency and data residency controls

Requested next steps:
1) Assign primary CS steward and tech lead for the pilot
2) Schedule a 60-min kickoff (agenda attached) — prefer the week of Oct 11
3) Confirm security evidence deliverables for SOC2 + network checklist

Monica and Karthik — can one of you own the kickoff and initial runbook? Alyssa — welcome aboard; please share the vendor access list (or let me know if you want Redwood to provide a secure upload link).

Attachments: Healthwise_onboarding_agenda_20271004.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Handoff — Healthwise implementation kickoff & owners

Thanks Ben — great close. Internal owners, please see the operational constraints Ben captured above. A couple of notes before we reach out to schedule:

- Primary CS steward: Monica Patel will be the day-to-day (ownership: kickoff, runbook, success criteria, weekly ops cadence). Monica — please confirm availability for Oct 11–15.
- Technical lead: Karthik Iyer will cover staging, private deployment orchestration, and load testing. Karthik — plan to validate the KV cache and quantization profile during the first integration sprint.
- I'll be the executive sponsor and will coordinate escalation/contract questions.

Action items (internal):
- Monica: draft a high-level 8-week pilot plan and a 30/60/90 success metric draft by EOD Oct 7. Attach the initial mutual action plan to that draft. (Attachment: HW_mutual_action_plan.xlsx)
- Karthik: send the preliminary infra checklist for their infra team — include VPC peering steps and recommended instance types for private deployment.
- Ben: confirm legal has kicked the DocuSign certificate for the amended data addendum.

I am sharing a HubSpot link to the deal and the DocuSign envelope for the redline we tracked. Please add any customer-specific security tasks to the runbook (PHI handling, KMS keys).

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027094, https://www.docusign.com/en/link/0f3b9c2a
Attachments: HW_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

—Vivek

Hi all — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Data residency: the pilot absolutely needs logs and inference to remain in our VPC; can you confirm Redwood’s recommended approach for KMS integration and whether token logs can be excluded from your telemetry?
2) Timeline: Oct 11–15 works for a kickoff window; prefer a morning slot (PST) the 12th if you're able.
3) Procurement: I copied our procurement inbox; they’ll confirm the PO toggle and return a signed copy by EOD Oct 7.

I attached the vendor access list we typically provide — it has the minimal accounts we can open for initial work. Let me know if you need additional details for the peering request.

Attachment: vendor_access_list.csv (CSV, 3KB)

Regards,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Product Ops — Healthwise

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@healthwise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@healthwise.ai
Date: 2027-10-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff — Healthwise implementation kickoff & owners

Alyssa — thanks and welcome. I’ll take primary ownership of the pilot and I’ll propose a concrete kickoff agenda and time within the hour. Quick answers to your questions inline:

> Data residency: the pilot absolutely needs logs and inference to remain in our VPC; can you confirm Redwood’s recommended approach for KMS integration and whether token logs can be excluded from your telemetry?

Yes — for private deployments we support customer-managed KMS and can disable telemetry collection of raw token streams. We will surface only high-level metrics (latency, error rates, token counts) to our console unless you opt in to richer traces. Karthik, I’ll need your infra checklist to match our recommended subnet/CIDR ranges and the KMS ARN pattern.

> Timeline: Oct 11–15 works for a kickoff window; prefer a morning slot (PST) the 12th if you're able.

We can do Tue Oct 12, 9:30–10:30 AM PST. Proposed attendees: Alyssa, Healthwise infra lead, Monica (CS), Karthik (tech lead), Ben (sales exec), Vivek (exec sponsor). I’ll send a calendar invite after Ben confirms legal status of the DocuSign.

Next visible deliverables from us:
- Detailed 8-week pilot plan and acceptance criteria (shared Oct 7)
- Infra checklist and peering template (Karthik — target Oct 6)
- Kickoff slide deck + initial runbook (I'll circulate Oct 11 morning)

Looking forward — putting the kickoff on my calendar tentatively for Oct 12 at 9:30 AM PST.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0133
